pattern: Do not state an unverified claim as a fact.
criterion: Do not state an unverified claim as a fact.

lesson.title: Verify Product Details Before Stating Them
lesson.when: Responding to a customer about an order or item when the system tools or sources return no order details or product information
lesson.do: Ask the customer to clarify or provide the correct details without stating specific unverified product names, sizes, colors, or order IDs
lesson.otherwise: Express uncertainty about the missing details and state that the system currently lacks that information
triggers: đơn hàng không có thông tin
chưa thấy thông tin đơn hàng
